terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Front, side and back orthographic-like views are available; perspective and hidden hinge stops remain inferred.

objectClass.notes: Three admitted views establish the exterior shell, open lid, platter, tonearm, front grille, rear hinges, handle and I/O plate. Internal motor, belt and wiring are inferred.

reasoning: Low rectangular base plus hinged lid, platter/tonearm mechanism, grille repetition, rear hardware, and a visible playback animation make this a complex compound appliance.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Every identity-defining detail is linked to a component or material override below.

details.description: Cream rounded base shell with softened front and side corners.
Raised transparent lid frame with inset inner panel.
Two pink rear hinge blocks and barrel pins.
Dark circular platter with thin pink perimeter band.
Central spindle pin and concentric record label ring.
Bent cream tonearm rooted at rear-right pivot.
Pink rectangular cartridge at stylus end.
Dense horizontal pink slat field across front panel.
Pink cylindrical speed/volume knob on top-right.
Centered recessed carry handle with two pink mounts.
Pink rear I/O plate with two circular sockets.
Four separate dark-pink rubber feet under shell.
Small power indicator beside control area.

definitionOfDone: The rendered record player matches the reference silhouette, hinged lid proportion, platter/tonearm layout, front grille rhythm, rear hardware and Sakura pastel material response while remaining animation-ready.

featureGroups.name: Rounded shell proportion
qualityCriteria: Height/width 1.12 and depth/width 0.72 with broad corner radii.

featureGroups.name: Platter and tonearm mechanism
qualityCriteria: Platter, center spindle, tonearm pivot, cartridge and stylus remain independently named around the playback axis.
failureModes: fused platter/tonearm parts or off-axis spindle

featureGroups.name: Front speaker grille
qualityCriteria: Eleven horizontal pink slats remain raised inside a dark recessed front cavity.
failureModes: flat grille decal or wrong slat rhythm

featureGroups.name: Rear hinges, carry handle and I/O plate
qualityCriteria: Two hinges, centered recessed handle and two circular sockets remain readable from the back.
failureModes: missing rear hardware or fused handle

featureGroups.name: Powered purpose animation
qualityCriteria: Control turns, platter spins and tonearm cues while the status light activates, then all transforms reset at 5.2 seconds.
failureModes: generic wobble without recognizable record playback

antiShallowSpecRules: No flat texture replacement for platter, tonearm or grille.

mustMatch: low rounded suitcase-like shell and lid proportions
dark platter with pink perimeter and central spindle
rear hinges, handle and dual I/O sockets
reference-derived PBR response at or above 0.7 confidence

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: render screenshot, side-by-side comparison, AI vision score and feature scores

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: assembled rounded suitcase enclosure with separate lid and mechanical subassemblies

componentTree.name: Rounded Base Shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rounded molded suitcase base with a broad rectangular footprint, softened corners, front grille recess and visible shell seam.

componentTree.name: Hinged Lid Assembly

componentTree.name: Transparent Lid Panel
componentTree.topologyRationale: Transparent inset panel retained inside the rounded lid frame.

componentTree.name: Top Lid Latch
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small centered latch block fixed to the upper rim of the dust cover.

componentTree.name: Rear Hinge Pair
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two discrete rear hinge blocks with barrel-pin axes join the lid to the base.

componentTree.name: Platter Assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Stationary support group locating the horizontal platter, spindle and inferred drive under the open lid.

componentTree.name: Black Vinyl Platter
componentTree.topologyRationale: Horizontal circular turntable and vinyl-disc assembly rotating about the vertical spindle axis.

componentTree.name: Record Label Ring
componentTree.topologyRationale: Concentric label disc fixed to the rotating vinyl record.

componentTree.name: Center Spindle
componentTree.topologyRationale: Short vertical metal spindle centered in the platter.

componentTree.name: Tonearm Assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rear-right pivot base and cueing support that anchors the articulated tonearm.

componentTree.name: Bent Tonearm
componentTree.topologyRationale: Bent cream tonearm rotating in plan around its rear-right pivot toward the record.

componentTree.name: Pink Cartridge
componentTree.topologyRationale: Pink rectangular cartridge attached to the distal end of the tonearm.

componentTree.name: Stylus Tip
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small stylus tip descending from the cartridge toward the record surface.

componentTree.name: Front Speaker Grille
componentTree.topologyRationale: Shallow rounded rectangular speaker cavity inset into the lower front face.

componentTree.name: Horizontal Grille Slats
componentTree.topologyRationale: Eleven separate horizontal rounded slats repeat across the front speaker cavity.

componentTree.name: Speed Control Knob
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent pink cylindrical speed or volume knob on the top-right control deck.

componentTree.name: Power Status Indicator
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small indicator lens beside the control area, emissive only while powered.

componentTree.name: Recessed Carry Handle
componentTree.topologyRationale: Centered recessed carry handle attached to the rear panel.

componentTree.name: Handle Mount Blocks
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two pink mounting blocks fix the carry handle to the rear panel.

componentTree.name: Rear I/O Plate
componentTree.topologyRationale: Pink rectangular I/O plate inset at the lower-right rear face.

componentTree.name: Rear Circular Sockets
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two separate circular sockets nested in the rear I/O plate.

componentTree.name: Four Rubber Feet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four discrete rubber feet repeat beneath the base corners.

componentTree.name: Shell Seam Rail
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin perimeter split line separates upper deck and lower shell panels.

componentTree.name: Inferred Power Socket
componentTree.topologyRationale: External power inlet inferred from the rear I/O layout and project plug contract; exact connector geometry is not fully visible.

componentTree.name: Inferred Motor Housing
componentTree.topologyRationale: Hidden motor and belt-drive volume beneath the platter, represented only as a low-confidence inferred runtime anchor.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Reuse shared geometries for grille slats and feet; keep transparent lid and key mechanism meshes separate.

lightingFromPhoto: key light: warm soft directional from upper front-left, intensity 3.0, broad contact shadow
fill light: cool neutral from right-rear, intensity 1.2 to reveal lid thickness and tonearm
rim light: Sakura pink from rear-left, intensity 1.4 separating lid and shell
exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping intent
pale warm background with low-opacity ground/contact shadow under four feet
proceduralStrategy: Block out the low suitcase shell and raised lid first.
Separate platter, tonearm, cartridge, grille slats, hinges, handle and I/O plate into named components.
Use stable pivots for lid hinge, platter spindle, tonearm cue and control knob; expose power socket and stylus sockets.
Use independent pastel PBR materials and transparent lid depth-write disabled.
Animate power as a recognizable platter spin, tonearm cueing and status-light pulse.
animationAnchors: lid-hinge-pivot rotates around rear hinge axis
tonearm-pivot sweeps stylus over platter with cartridge socket
power-connection-socket anchors cable and start signal
destructionAnchors: lid and hinge pair form one detachable shell group
front grille slat array remains a separate breakable group
platter/tonearm assembly can detach from body shell without fusing visual meshes
risks: transparent lid may require depthWrite=false and explicit render order
rear I/O connector identities remain inferred from circular openings
stylus groove contact is stylized to maintain browser performance
